_note: An example of the catalogue the extensions page lists from, and nothing reads this file. The real one is index.json in the directory core.modules names, which GET /api/v1/modules/index answers from; the page reads that operation through the SDK. `make demo` writes one of these for you, with both rows and a source pointing at the archive it just packed on your own machine. The sources below are where a published release will live once the examples are released.

modules.name: Spools
modules.description: Tracks the filament spools on each printer, on a page of its own.
modules.author: Prusa Research

modules.name: Nozzle watch
modules.description: Adds a nozzle temperature section to each printer's Status tab. It is a browser bundle with no server process.
modules.author: Prusa Research
